# GUI Interface Description: Mozilla Thunderbird

## System Environment

- **Desktop Environment**: Ubuntu or similar Linux distribution with a dark theme.
- **Top Bar**:
  - Left: "Activities" button.
  - Center: Date and time display: "Oct 22 23:59".
  - Right: System status icons including network, sound, and power.

## Application Window: Mozilla Thunderbird

### Window Title Bar
- Title: "Important - Local Folders - Mozilla Thunderbird".
- Window controls: Minimize, Maximize, Close buttons on the right.

### Top Menu Bar
- **Search Bar**: A rounded rectangular search field with placeholder text "Type to search" and a magnifying glass icon on the left.
- **Quick Filter**: A button labeled "Quick Filter" with a filter icon, located near the center-right of the top bar.

### Left Sidebar (Navigation Panel)

#### Application Icons (Top to Bottom)
- Mail icon (envelope).
- Address book icon.
- Calendar icon.
- Tasks icon (checkmark).
- Chat icon (speech bubble).

#### Account and Folders
- **Account**: "mathias.gadenzi@gmail.com" with a folder icon.
- **Local Folders** (expanded):
  - Trash (with trash can icon).
  - Outbox (with envelope icon).
  - Important (highlighted with folder icon).

#### Bottom of Sidebar
- Settings gear icon.
- Back arrow icon.

### Main Content Area

#### Message List
- **Folder Name**: "Important".
- **Message Count**: "0 Messages".
- **Search Field**: "Search... CTRL + K" with a magnifying glass icon.
- **Quick Filter Button**: Located to the right of the search field.

#### Empty Space
- The main content area is empty, indicating no messages are present in the "Important" folder.

### Right Panel (Welcome Screen)

#### Header
- **Logo**: Thunderbird logo with "Thunderbird ESR" text.
- **Title**: "Welcome to FREEDOM" in large, bold font.
- **Subtitle**: "Thunderbird is a gift from thousands of people like you. We hope you'll enjoy the productivity, privacy, and freedom they make possible and we invite you to become part of that gift to others."

#### Donate Button
- **Button**: Blue button with a heart icon and text "Donate".
- **Text Below**: "Help keep Thunderbird alive!".

#### Two Information Cards

##### Card 1: Free and Open Source
- **Title**: "Free and Open Source".
- **Subtitle**: "Thunderbird is now yours forever."
- **Description**: "Thunderbird is developed openly and distributed freely. Our software license protects your right to use, modify, and share Thunderbird. Our mission is to protect your privacy and freedom."
- **Button**: "Get Help" with a heart icon.

##### Card 2: Powered by Community
- **Title**: "Powered by Community".
- **Subtitle**: "You can become part of our story."
- **Description**: "Anyone can contribute to Thunderbird. By donating, translating, answering questions, suggesting features, reporting bugs, and more, you make Thunderbird better for yourself and the world."
- **Button**: "Participate" with a pencil icon.

#### Bottom Section
- **Text**: "Want new features sooner? Learn about Thunderbird Release."
- **Button**: "Thunderbird Release" in blue text.

## Desktop Icons (Left Dock)

- **Activities**: Top-left icon.
- **Applications**: Icons for Chrome, Thunderbird, Visual Studio Code, VLC Media Player, LibreOffice Writer, LibreOffice Calc, LibreOffice Impress, GIMP, Files, Ubuntu Software, Help, Trash.

## System Tray (Bottom Right)

- **Icons**: System tray icons including network, sound, and power.

## Desktop Wallpaper

- **Background**: A gradient of dark purple to black on the right side of the screen.
